method.text: Each season's ADP top-150 at QB/RB/WR/TE, GSIS-matched (~145-150 players).
Every player's anchor is the expert-consensus rank: log(ECR) when a preseason snapshot exists, else log(ADP); ordinally re-ranked per season.
A per-position quadratic, fit walk-forward on prior seasons and clamped monotone, converts the anchor rank into expected log season points: what a player at that rank historically scores.

A ridge regression over 51 standardized preseason features predicts the gap between actual and anchor-implied points (residual clipped +/-4); a shrunken fraction of that correction is added back. Position is never a feature; it enters only via the per-position anchor and the VORP curve.

Projections map through a drafted-slot points curve (prior seasons only) to value over replacement: QB8/RB30/WR36/TE8, streaming-aware at QB/TE. The ECR and ADP baselines go through the identical conversion.
Season t uses only seasons < t outcomes plus season-t preseason facts. No leakage.
Ridge strength and shrink are chosen on the 2012-2017 window (frozen grid, re-derived each run); the test seasons are never touched for decisions.

limitations: Test set is 8 seasons (2018-2025); the sign-flip one-sided power floor is 0.0039, so significance at 0.05 is reachable.
Hyperparameters are tuned on an earlier walk-forward window; fit to the current anchor configuration is untested by construction (alpha=100).
Some rookies run on partly or fully null-filled opportunity features.
Replacement levels fixed for 12-team 1-QB PPR; other formats shift the QB/TE placements.
